note: Two editions of one riwayah, and the distance between them. Regenerate with `pnpm edition:diff` and read the diff. A change in these numbers is a change in where every annotation lands.

source.confidence: measured, not asserted: all 6236 ayahs are byte-identical to that column after three mechanical steps — strip the CSV quoting, strip the trailing ayah-number presentation glyph, and replace the 199 non-breaking spaces after the hizb sign with ordinary spaces. Nothing else differs anywhere.
how_to_reproduce: 2. Read 'UthmanicHafs_v2-0 data/hafsData_v2-0.csv' as UTF-8. It is comma-separated with a BOM; the columns used are sura_no, aya_no and aya_text.

3. For each row take aya_text and apply, in order: strip one leading and one trailing double quote; strip a trailing run of Arabic presentation forms (U+FB50..U+FDFF, U+FE70..U+FEFF) together with any whitespace or U+00A0 before it — that is the ayah-number glyph, e.g. U+FC00 on 1:1; then trim.
4. Replace every U+00A0 with U+0020. There are exactly 199, one after each hizb sign, and 199 is the number of hizb signs in Hafs.
5. Compare with this file's ayahs, keyed sura:ayah. All 6236 are equal.
source.note: This was open for a long time. The file said only 'legacy application export', the README said it was the text published at tajweed.quranpedia.net, and LICENSE asserted a KFGQPC derivation that nobody could check. The derivation is now checkable: it is the 2022 v2 release, not the 2026 v3.0 one that quran-ws/quran-text carries. That is why 35:43 is composed here and decomposed there, and why only 2715 of 6236 ayahs match quran-text byte for byte.
source.found_by: quran-ws/quran-text, which noticed that 35:43 differs between the two releases and pointed at the v2 line as the likely origin.

reconciledBy.what: the order of the marks stacked on one letter
a precomposed letter (آ أ ؤ ئ) against a base letter plus a combining mark
positional tanween (U+0657 U+065E U+0656) against open tanween (U+08F0 U+08F1 U+08F2)

normalisation.note: Ayahs that reach the matchers as the same string. The four real textual differences are included in the remainder and cannot be normalised away.
